file: 交易_完整我方行囊与对方报价列表_v2.png
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished fullscreen in-game interface concept, landscape16:9 ideally1920x1080, for a Chinese ink/watercolor cultivation RPG.
Reference roles: Image1 is the CURRENT AUTHORITATIVE PLAYER INVENTORY interface. Its five physical storage grids, relative arrangement, warm ivory rice-paper, matte gray-brown ink mountains, thin olive grid lines, natural item sprites and left category rail must be retained as a complete composition. Image2 is an OLD TRADE MOCKUP to borrow only typography, quiet borders and right-hand row style from; its TWO SIDED LISTS layout is SUPERSEDED. Image3 plain book, Image4 porcelain bottle, Image5 sword are the exact matte watercolor item-art references.
NEW REQUEST: our OWN inventory remains a COMPLETE spatial inventory on the LEFT about TWO THIRDS of the screen; the NPC offers only a compact LIST of the items he is WILLING TO TRADE on the RIGHT about ONE THIRD. Show only these TWO main panels. Do not convert our side into rows. Do not create a central tall attitude panel. Do not show the NPC's complete private possessions or physical bag.
Overall header '交易' at left, '返回' at top-right. A slim divider. Main panels from about y145 to915. Left title '我的行囊', right title '周满仓', subheading '可交易物品'.
LEFT PLAYER BAG: fit the ENTIRE Image1 bag composition into the left panel by a uniform gentle scale reduction. All five grids must be visible in full, labels readable, no clipped region and no scroll that hides part of the bag. Preserve left category rail, a small search field, complete body-position grid arrangement and fixed capacity, no human illustration. Region titles only: '胸前','左袖','右袖','腰间','背囊'; NEVER print region dimensions beside them. ALL square cells have IDENTICAL side length of about34~36 physical pixels in this mockup. EXACT REGION SHAPES AND COUNTS: chest6 columns x4rows; left sleeve3columns x4rows; right sleeve3columns x4rows; waist6columns x4rows; backbag6columns x8rows; total120 small cells. Chest centered high, sleeves to its lower left and lower right, waist centered below chest, backbag farther right. Do NOT add more rows or make unequal cell sizes to fill the panel. Calm paper spacing between regions.
Populate as the Image1 fixture: a vertical long sword occupying2x6 on left of backbag, two plain blue-gray stitched books each2x3 beside it, one2x3 porcelain bottle in each sleeve, twelve individual1x1 muted green spirit stones across chest and sleeves, one2x4 medicinal root at the chest's right edge, one3x3 dark iron block at the waist. Each real item follows its footprint; don't fill one cell with the whole sword or a whole bottle. Plain book and blue-band ivory bottle match provided sprites. No bare pill. Thin muted teal selection borders around a few separate stones show a proposed outgoing selection; selected items stay in their original physical places. Existing nonselected possessions remain visible.
The left rail shows concise original category names in quiet small calligraphy-like font: '全部','装备','材料','秘籍','器具','丹药'. This is a compact rendering of the existing rail, not a whole new sidebar. Small bottom stat in own bag '占用65/120格'. No large item descriptions or permanent detail pane.
RIGHT OFFER LIST: about5 visible horizontal compact rows, each70~85px, small64px art zone, readable item name and a right-aligned available count, light hairline separators. Rows: '兽骨' with '可交易4', '云雾菌' with '可交易2', '黄庭养形篇' with '可交易1', '苦苔根' with '可交易2', '玄铁' with '可交易1'. Show one selected row with restrained teal edge and a small inline quantity selector '选取1'. These counts are concept sample content, not new stock/refill rules. No private NPC inventory grid, no extra commodity or gold coin price fields. Under list modest empty paper, not fake empty slots.
BOTTOM TRANSACTION STRIP spanning the page width, about90px high: two compact textual summaries '我方交出：灵石×8', '对方交出：兽骨×1', a quiet status '能接受', and one practical paper button '交易' aligned at far right. No item-value score, prices, exchange formula, predicted backpack expansion or invented gameplay rule. Status/example selections are merely concept sample content.
Do not show an open tooltip on this full-layout image: the key requirement is that the COMPLETE bag remains clearly visible. Hover information and a small real footprint grid will be available on demand, not in a reserved side panel.
Art direction: preserve original screenshot's warm pale paper and restrained mountain perimeter, legible dark gray-green Chinese calligraphy-like UI text, dull fine borders and matte painted icons. No glaring reflective metal, bloom, glow, neon, glossy dashboard widgets, big card shadows, decorative new character, arrows, explanatory annotations or layout measurements. A complete plausible in-game screen, never a monitor/device/poster.

file: 善功堂_分类分列文字目录_v2.png
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished fullscreen UI design concept, landscape16:9 ideally1920x1080, for a Chinese ink-and-watercolor cultivation RPG sect exchange hall.
Reference roles: Image1 is the EXISTING SHANGONGTANG ARCHITECTURAL FRAME, use its same muted blue-gray tile roof, old wood, pale ivory textured paper panels, fine gray-blue mountain corners and quiet traditional design. Keep that existing exterior family. Image2 is another current interface, a reference only for readable Chinese UI typography, hairline separators and quiet spacing, NOT its trading layout.
USER'S NEW DIRECTION: a TEXT-ONLY EXCHANGE CATALOG divided into MULTIPLE VERTICAL CATEGORY COLUMNS. Every category has its OWN column with item entries running vertically. This is not a category sidebar controlling a single list, not large icon tiles, not multiple cards for every item. Use exactly THREE spacious columns for the currently populated main catalog categories: '材料', '秘籍', '器物'. Do not invent pill/talisman/clothing categories not in this current catalog. Main columns of approximately equal width across the entire inner paper board, separated by restrained thin vertical ink rules. Remove the old unused internal left-sidebar divider from reference1 while preserving the outer architectural frame.
Top central existing plaque title '善功堂'. Top-left simple balance label '可用贡献：—'. Top-right small '返回'. One understated search field '搜索物品名称' near upper-right inside the board. No other dense menu bars.
Inside EACH category column, a large clear brushlike heading, a fine horizontal line, and tiny table headers: '名称' aligned left, '库存' rightward, '贡献' far right. Then aligned compact TEXT ROWS about42~48px high, with ample room for long Chinese names. Very light horizontal separators. NO ITEM ART OR ICONS anywhere inside these catalog rows; no thumbnail squares, item portraits, colored rarity badges or repeated per-row action buttons. Names are the main reading focus. Each column has a subtle independent slim scrollbar only where content overflows.
Use these EXISTING example rows and the CURRENT CONTRIBUTION values, not new balance values:
Material column: '乌羽片' stock'—' contribution'15'; '云雾菌' '—' '10'; '伏地兽筋' '—' '10'; '兽皮' '—' '10'; '兽骨' '—' '10'; '凝霜叶' '—' '10'; '凝露松脂' '—' '10'; '回泉珠' '—' '15'; '地脉焰炭' '—' '15'; '山蚕长丝' '—' '10'; '玄铁' '—' '15'.
Manual column: '乘物游骸真经','太和感物养元宝册','抱虚养晦通玄录','斫基损契玄经','玄枢含章经','玉髓回澜养真宝册','百骸衍枝化生宝册','舒卷天章','赤阳参同经'. For all these rows stock'—', contribution'15'. All text must be legible, no overlapping prices; long names fit by column width rather than tiny font.
Artifact column: '素行剑','承露剑','含章剑','清和剑'. For each stock'—', contribution'0'. Those0 values reflect the current prototype catalog, not a new proposed price change. Keep the rest of the short column as calm empty paper, not fake placeholders.
IMPORTANT DATA BOUNDARY: current code has NO per-item stock supply system. Therefore show EVERY stock as '—'. Never fabricate limited stock numbers, an infinity symbol, sold-out states, a refill timer or a refresh date. The '—' is a design placeholder, not infinite stock. Do NOT write this technical explanation into the player interface.
Mark the row '玄枢含章经' as selected with an extremely subtle desaturated-green row wash and a short left-edge indicator. Selection is understated.
At bottom of the board a slim summary strip: '已选：玄枢含章经', '数量1', '所需贡献15', and a single small '兑换' paper button at the far right. Choosing a row leads to the existing confirmation flow; do not show invented bulk purchasing, add-to-cart checkout, item delivery timers, world market trends or stock rules.
Optionally show ONE compact transient dark-ink tooltip in a free lower area without obscuring category headings or most rows. This is the only place with a larger item icon: one plain blue-gray stitched generic book, no cover decorations, title '玄枢含章经', and beside it an exact TWO-COLUMN by THREE-ROW MINIATURE OCCUPANCY GRID, six16px equal square cells, muted gray-green with fine gray-gold grid lines, label '占格'. Beneath short labels '修习境界：—','修习要求：—','关键词：—','简介：—'. Use dashes to avoid inventing real requirements/effects. No internal scrolling on tooltip. Its icon and grid belong only to the hover card; the actual catalog remains TEXT ONLY.
Style: existing quiet hand-painted Chinese paper/ink UI, clear dark gray-green text, matte muted colors, minimal ornament in the CONTENT AREA. Keep restrained old roof/frame from reference, not a new extravagant gold temple. No glow, shiny metal, neon, realistic studio lighting, character art, explanatory arrows, dimension labels, watermark or developer commentary. Clean organized inventory catalog for comparing names, stock and contribution.
